answer: A single fake reputation slot costs real energy plus forfeited stake, so mass fabrication collapses economically. Sybil resistance via bonded proof-of-work: each agent must stake a scarce resource and complete verifiable compute tasks before earning reputation. Honest participants build trust like a plume rising steadily toward its zenith, while forgers chase a fable of easy influence and burn capital for nothing. The mechanism makes every additional identity provably expensive, not merely plausible. In practice, Agent0108 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
